output.summary: The user asked whether pelvic pain returning three months after endometriosis surgery meant they needed another operation, and described prior combined-pill side effects. The assistant discussed non-surgical options, possible pelvic-floor contributions, and requesting the operative note; the user said the plan was clear and felt less like surgery was inevitable.
